bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · capped by the 100-day average
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 受制于 100 日均线

read.en: AMD rose 1.7% on Oct 23 to $516.79, trading between $508.36 and $523.92. It is below the falling 5-day ($530.1) and 10-day ($551.2) and the rising 30-day ($582.4) and 100-day ($526.6), but above the rising 200-day ($402.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and below zero, histogram narrowing slightly; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($563.64), and RSI is 39.
read.zh: AMD 10月23日上涨 1.7%，收于 $516.79，盘中区间 $508.36–523.92。股价位于下行的 5 日（$530.1）和 10 日（$551.2）以及上行的 30 日（$582.4）和 100 日均线（$526.6）下方，但高于上行的 200 日均线（$402.1）。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图略有收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$563.64），RSI 为 39。

read.en: The rebound stayed under Wednesday's break: the $523.9 high stopped short of the $526.6–530 zone (100-day, Oct 22 high), still resistance. Resistance is $526.6–530, then $548–551 (Oct 20 high, 10-day) and $563.6 (SAR). Support is $508.4 (Oct 23 low), then $495–502.6 (late-June and early-July lows, Oct 22 low) and $460. A close above $530 would target $548–551; a close below $495 would open $460.
read.zh: 反弹未能收复周三破位：$523.9 高点未触及 $526.6–530 区间（100 日均线、10月22日高点），该区间仍为阻力。阻力为 $526.6–530，其次 $548–551（10月20日高点、10 日均线）和 $563.6（SAR）。支撑为 $508.4（10月23日低点），其次 $495–502.6（6 月下旬和 7 月初低点、10月22日低点）和 $460。若收盘站上 $530，下一目标看 $548–551；若收盘跌破 $495，将打开 $460。

s.en: Late-June and early-July lows ($495–498); Oct 22 low $502.6
